card.name: Linking words before a text or scripture
card.fires_on: Small linking words and brackets right after a word for a book or written text (Torah, Genesis, OT, law text, instruction). They come where the next word could be a name of the text or its parts.

modes.label: Scripture context
modes.description: Small word or opening bracket after a biblical book or Old Testament reference.
modes.example: translate the Torah<< (>>or Pentateuch) from Biblical Hebrew

modes.label: Reading or instruction comparisons
modes.description: A linking word such as to or the in a comparison of texts or teaching methods.
modes.example: found phonics superior<< to>> whole word instruction and "systematic"

modes.label: Start of a word
modes.description: The first piece of a word like intratracheally or intrinsic.

card.writes: It suppresses the word text in many languages, so it steers the model away from saying text next.
card.plain: It fires on little words after a book or scripture name, where the model is less likely to say the word text next.
